CustomField.description: "MFC" means a customer of Tanium who receives pricing terms, net of discounts and rebates, that are no less favorable than those received by any other Similarly Situated Customer.If Tanium offers more favorable pricing to any other Similarly Situated Customer than offered to Customer under any signed Schedule, Tanium will extend the comparable pricing to Customer (for future purchases only) for any overage amount.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: "MFC" means a customer of Tanium who receives pricing terms, net of discounts and rebates, that are no less favorable than those received by any other Similarly Situated Customer.
CustomField.label: Most Favored Customer
